proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ ⟨a, b, hab⟩
  constructor
  · refine (Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top (inferInstance : (commutator G).Normal)).resolve_left fun h => hab ?_
    have := Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top a) (Subgroup.mem_top b)
    rw [← commutator_def, h, Subgroup.mem_bot] at this
    exact commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm.1 this
  · refine (Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top (inferInstance : (Subgroup.center G).Normal)).resolve_right fun h => hab ?_
    have ha : a ∈ Subgroup.center G := by rw [h]; trivial
    exact ((Subgroup.mem_center_iff.1 ha) b).symm
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [IsSimpleGroup G], (∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) → commutator G = ⊤ ∧ Subgroup.center G = ⊥
